commit.subject: LU-20498 efalnd: Fix self peer NI return value check
commit.message:
LU-20498 efalnd: Fix self peer NI return value check

Self peer NI creation returns an error pointer so checking only for NULL
isn't correct and will lead to a crash on NI shutdown due to invalid
memory dereference.

Fixes: 0c773016d837 ("LU-18977 efalnd: Introduce AWS EFA Lustre network driver")
Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Yonatan Nachum <ynachum@amazon.com>
Change-Id: Ifa41f1a0a4a26da839a47a47e79bdefe8e8ca76e
Reviewed-on: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/67384
Reviewed-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
